title: Native personal-token persistence failure envelope
classification: The native application error boundary safely handles injected persistence failures for the personal-token API.

method.application: FastAPI personal-token routes with the production ASGI exception handlers installed.
method.fault: Injected adapter exceptions in list, create, and revoke operations; synthetic error text stood in for database diagnostics.
assertions: all three routes return HTTP 500 with the internal error code
the response uses the generic user-facing error message
synthetic database diagnostics do not appear in the response

limits: Fault injection used a RuntimeError from the test adapter, not a live SQLAlchemy connection failure.
Paired exact-image failure responses were not captured.
